QUOTE: `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.json` | A `path` row per file, zero symbols | Findable by name, but no `memberdef`, so no keys (`steps:`, etc.) enter the symbol namespace.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states YAML/JSON are indexed as files (path rows) with zero symbols, contrasting with shell/CMake which carry function symbols, so the two groups are treated differently.
